Celebrate a special milestone with this Gold Donut Grow Up Balloon Kit. This aluminum foil decoration set features 11 letter balloons spelling "DOUNT GROW UP" alongside a large 24-inch doughnut balloon, perfect for creating a fun and festive atmosphere at any donut-themed party.

The kit includes everything you need for easy setup: one straw for inflation and one ribbon for hanging. The letter balloons measure 16 inches each, providing a bold and eye-catching display for dessert tables, walls, or ceilings.

Please note that these aluminum foil balloons do not float, even when filled with helium. For the best results, stick them to the wall or hang them using the included ribbon to showcase your birthday celebration style.
bullets: Includes 11 letter balloons spelling "DOUNT GROW UP" for a personalized birthday message.
Features a large 24-inch gold doughnut balloon as the centerpiece of your party decor.
Comes with a straw and ribbon for convenient inflation and secure hanging.

Durable aluminum foil material ensures a shiny and vibrant gold finish.

reference.title: 3-Piece Black Burgundy Microfiber Comforter Set Full Queen Classic Box-Stitch Down Alternative
reference.description:
Upgrade your bedroom with this 3-piece comforter set in a sophisticated black and burgundy color scheme. Designed for the Full/Queen bed, this set includes one 86" x 86" comforter and two 20" x 30" shams, offering a complete and cohesive look for your space.

Crafted from silky soft microfiber, this down alternative filling provides medium warmth ideal for year-round comfort. The classic box-stitching design ensures the filling stays evenly distributed, preventing shifting or bunching while maintaining a plush, lofted appearance.

Convenience meets durability with this machine-washable set. The durable microfiber material is easy to care for, making it a practical choice for everyday use. Its classic style and versatile colors allow it to blend seamlessly with various bedroom decors.
bullets: Includes a 3-piece set with one 86x86 comforter and two 20x30 shams for Full/Queen beds.
Made from soft microfiber down alternative for a cozy, breathable sleeping experience.
Features a classic box-stitching design to keep filling in place and prevent shifting.

reference.title: Set of Two Dried Rose Pot Holders, Heat Resistant Cotton with Silicone Grip, 6.5x10 Inches
reference.description:
Protect your hands while cooking with this set of two dried rose pot holders. Made from heat-resistant cotton, they provide a comfortable and secure way to handle hot pots, pans, and dishes. The soft fabric ensures flexibility and insulation against high temperatures.

Each pot holder features a textured, heart-shaped silicone grip that ensures a firm hold on slippery cookware. A convenient slide pocket allows for easy on-and-off use, while a hanging loop makes storage simple and tidy. Measuring 6.5 inches wide by 10 inches long, they are sized for practical everyday use.

These pot holders are machine washable for easy care and maintenance. Crafted from 100% cotton with silicone grips, they combine durability with style. Perfect for adding a touch of color to your kitchen while keeping your hands safe.
bullets: Set of two heat-resistant cotton pot holders protects hands from hot cookware.
Heart-shaped silicone grips provide a secure hold on slippery pots and pans.
Slide pocket design allows for easy on-and-off use while cooking.
Hanging loop enables convenient storage and display in your kitchen.
Machine washable fabric ensures easy cleaning and long-lasting use.
